title: Garry Nolan debunking Atacama mummy
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Garry Nolan debunking Atacama mummy, about an unknown time at Atacama, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Nolan where he got into becoming the UFO

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, mentions a man named Garry Nolan and a small mummified body from the Atacama region that some had claimed was not human. As Michels tells it, Nolan's work showing the mummy was not what it was claimed to be is how he first got drawn into the UFO field. It is told as the origin of someone Michels presents as holding a great deal of UFO evidence.
